/*selectBuyerMdCmMyGoodsSearchList*/ SELECT S.IMGFILE_NAME, --[01] S.IMGFILE_DIR, --[02] S.BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[03] S.DESCRIPTION, --[04] S.SPECIFICATION, --[05] S.ORIGIN_TEXT, --[06] S.MAKER_NAME, --[07] DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE =#{st_com_code}),'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)', S.AGENT_NAME) AGENT_NAME, --[08] S.UNIT_MEASURE, --[09] S.UNIT_PRICE, --[10] S.TARGET_QTY, --[11] S.AGENT, --[12] S.REG_DATE, --[13] S.CATEG_ID, --[14] S.CONTRACT_NO, --[15] S.CONTRACT_SEQ, --[16] S.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, --[17] S.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, --[18] DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE =#{st_com_code}),'N','KRKORE0001', S.AGENT) AGENT3, --[19]
S.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, --[20] S.HS_NO, --[21] S.MY_GROUP, S.MY_GROUP_NM, S.CART_SEQ FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, A.IMGFILE_NAME, A.IMGFILE_DIR, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.ORIGIN_TEXT, A.MAKER_NAME, A.AGENT_NAME, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.TARGET_QTY, A.AGENT, A.REG_DATE, A.CATEG_ID, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, A.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, A.HS_NO, A.MY_GROUP, A.MY_GROUP_NM, A.CART_SEQ FROM ( SELECT
DECODE(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME), NULL, (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=D.IMG_NO),B.IMGFILE_NAME) AS IMGFILE_NAME,
DECODE(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR), NULL, (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=D.IMG_NO),B.IMGFILE_DIR) AS IMGFILE_DIR,
C.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, Q.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION, Q.SPECIFICATION SPECIFICATION, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = Q.ORIGIN_CODE) ORIGIN_TEXT, Q.MAKER_NAME MAKER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT) AGENT_NAME, Q.UNIT_MEASURE UNIT_MEASURE, Q.UNIT_PRICE UNIT_PRICE, 0 TARGET_QTY, Q.AGENT AGENT, C.REG_DATE REG_DATE, B.CATEGORY_NO CATEG_ID, C.CONTRACT_NO CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ CONTRACT_SEQ, C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE BYCA_COMORG_CODE, B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, C.SEQ AS CART_SEQ, NVL(TRIM(B.OVER_SHORT_FLAG),'N') AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, TRIM(B.HS_NO) AS HS_NO, C.MY_GROUP, NVL((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.TYPE= 'ITEM' AND COD.BUYER = C.BUYER AND COD.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD.CODE2 = C.MY_GROUP AND FLAG = 'Y' ),'미분류') AS MY_GROUP_NM FROM ICOMCART C, ICOMCQDT Q, ICOMBYIT B, CMSCATLG D WHERE C.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND C.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND C.USE_FLAG = 'R' AND C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y') AND B.STATUS != 'D'
AND B.CMS_CATLG_ID = D.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND D.STD_FLAG(+)='Y'
AND C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = Q.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = Q.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND Q.STATUS != 'D' AND C.CONTRACT_NO = Q.CONTRACT_NO AND C.CONTRACT_SEQ = Q.CONTRACT_SEQ
AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_buyer_item_no})||'%'
AND Q.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%'
AND Q.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_specification}||'%'
AND Q.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%'
AND C.MY_GROUP = #{st_my_groups}
ORDER BY C.REG_DATE DESC )A ) S

AND C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = Q.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = Q.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND Q.STATUS != 'D' AND C.CONTRACT_NO = Q.CONTRACT_NO AND C.CONTRACT_SEQ = Q.CONTRACT_SEQ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCMPY CM, ICOMCQDT GC WHERE CM.COM_CODE = C.BUYER AND GC.BUYER = CM.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND GC.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND GC.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND GC.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND GC.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND GC.STATUS = 'D' )

mapper.select: /*getMyCatalgList*/ SELECT COD.CODE2,COD.TEXT1,NVL(A.DELETE_FLAG,'N') DELETE_FLAG FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , (SELECT C.MY_GROUP,C.BUYER,C.USER_ID,DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') AS DELETE_FLAG FROM ICOMCART C, ICOMCQDT Q, ICOMBYIT B WHERE C.BUYER = #{buyer} AND C.USER_ID = #{userid} AND C.USE_FLAG = 'R' AND C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y') AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND C.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = Q.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = Q.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND Q.STATUS != 'D' AND C.CONTRACT_NO = Q.CONTRACT_NO AND C.CONTRACT_SEQ = Q.CONTRACT_SEQ GROUP BY C.MY_GROUP,C.BUYER,C.USER_ID) A WHERE COD.BUYER = #{buyer} AND COD.CODE1 = #{userid} AND COD.CODE2 = A.MY_GROUP(+) AND COD.TYPE = 'ITEM' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.BUYER = A.BUYER(+) AND COD.CODE1 = A.USER_ID(+)
